page.title: Best Open-Ear Headphones with Mic for Calls (2026): AeroClip 2 vs Shokz OpenComm2
page.h1: Best open-ear headphones with a mic for calls
page.desc: Which open-ear headphones callers can actually hear: soundcore AeroClip 2 for calls on the move, Shokz OpenComm2 boom mic for all-day Teams, Nuroum OpenEar Pro 2 on a budget.
page.intro:
Short answer. The best open ear headphones with mic is the soundcore AeroClip 2 ({buy:soundcore-aeroclip-2}): 4 mics and 2 bone-conduction voice sensors on an AI chip, certified by Guinness World Records in August 2026 for the highest objective speech-quality score of any open-ear clip-on, in a 6.2 g IP57 bud with multipoint. The catch is battery: soundcore rates it at 5 hours of talk time per charge (8 hours for music) and 20 hours with the case, so it suits calls on the move, not eight hours on Teams. If you sit at a desk on calls all day and want a boom mic, the honest winner is the Shokz OpenComm2 (2025): a noise-cancelling boom, 16 hours of talk time, 35 g, IP55. We don't earn on it, so we link the maker.

Will people hear you in noise? Reviewers put the AeroClip 2 ahead of every open-ear rival for call clarity, including on a busy street and in wind, and its Whisper Mode keeps quiet speech intelligible. On the OpenComm2 UC, SoundGuys' reader poll of 1,078 votes rated the boom mic sample good or perfect 79% of the time, with street noise "virtually eliminated" and only some wind getting through. No open-ear design blocks noise for you, though: in a loud office you will still hear everything around you.

page.after:
What owners complain about

Three themes repeat across reviews and retailer feedback. First, talk time on earbuds: the AeroClip 2's 5-hour call rating is well under its 8-hour music figure, and Expert Reviews lists battery as its main weakness against Shokz OpenDots. Second, fit: the AeroClip 2 takes a few tries to clip in the right spot, and one runner felt a pinch until he moved it higher on the ear. On the OpenComm2, SoundGuys scored comfort 5.0 because the one-size band droops on small heads, and some owners report temple soreness and a tickle from the transducers at high volume. Third, volume and connection: about 10% of OpenComm2 reviews mention limited or uneven volume, and several Best Buy owners describe the headset dropping its link to a computer. Shokz's usual reply is a manual reset.

Which one by need

Calls on the commute, in the office, or between meetings: soundcore AeroClip 2 ({buy:soundcore-aeroclip-2}). Best voice pickup in the class, LDAC for music, and the case gets you through a workday if you drop the buds in it between calls.

Eight hours of Teams or Zoom at a desk: Shokz OpenComm2 (2025). Its 16-hour talk time and boom mic are why remote workers and truckers keep buying it. The UC version adds a USB dongle, which Headset Advisor recommends over Bluetooth for computer use.

Same job for less: Nuroum OpenEar Pro 2 at $129.00 on 2026-11-06 includes the dongle and a mute button on the boom. In Scott Dawson's side-by-side Teams test colleagues said he sounded fine on it but "louder and clearer" on the Shokz, and the thicker hooks tired him sooner.

Long days with glasses: Shokz OpenMeet UC. SoundGuys wore it eight hours without fatigue, but it slides when you look down, has no water rating, and RTINGS found the dongle's latency noticeable on video.

Runs and rides with the odd call: Shokz OpenFit 2, which Digital Trends found cut a passing cement truck to a whisper on a call. For a cheaper hook-style pair from a brand we earn on, the soundcore AeroFit 2 ({buy:soundcore-aerofit-2}) has 4 mics with AI call processing and 10 hours per charge.

Not recommended

Anything sold only as "open ear headphones with mic" under a no-name brand on marketplace listings: there is no independent mic test, no spec sheet, and no warranty to lean on. Skip the original Shokz OpenComm, which lacks a mute button and is being cleared out. And if you work in a loud shared office, no open-ear product will help you hear the other side; a closed headset with ANC is the right tool.
